name: pi
description: Run pi coding-agent jobs (any pi model, Grok by default) as native background subagents (pi:grok, pi:run): the native task list, SendMessage, TaskStop and finish notifications, confined by a macOS sandbox-exec profile.

piPath.title: pi binary
piPath.description: Path to the pi CLI binary (needs `pi --mode rpc`). When this path does not exist, `pi` is looked up on PATH.

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Node 18+ used to run the bridge process (and pi). When this path does not exist, `node` is looked up on PATH.

defaultEffort.title: Default effort
defaultEffort.description: pi thinking level when the prompt sets no effort: header line. per-model: each agent's own default (high).

defaultSandbox.title: Default sandbox
defaultSandbox.description: Sandbox when the prompt sets no sandbox: header line. workspace-write: writes only in the project, /tmp and pi's session dir; read-only: no project writes and read tools only; full-access: no sandbox.
